central_question: How can a wireless system optimize a physical task rather than simply carry more bytes?
claims_and_limits: King's College London tested semantic representations over a 5G robot-to-edge link, with up to 52.6% lower task completion time against periodic images in its setup.
SoftBank's roughly 60% maximum uplink gain is from a separate controlled neural-receiver experiment.
Leeds' 45.6% RAN-power reduction is against a full-power baseline in a four-base-station research setup; none are commercial 6G measurements.
